author: shared-claude
name: T01
source:
theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: shared-claude
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01]
  have a : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b : 0 ≤ (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) h5
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: shared-claude
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hS
  have hS' : m.S ≤ 0 := by omega
  have e : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ*(M*M) - (N*M)*m.S + (N*N)*(m.Du*m.Dv) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  have p1 : 0 < m.detJ*(M*M) := Int.mul_pos h1 (Int.mul_pos h4 h4)
  have p2 : 0 ≤ (N*M)*(-m.S) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg h5 (by omega)) (by omega)
  have p3 : 0 ≤ (N*N)*(m.Du*m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg h5 h5) (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega))
  have p2' : (N*M)*(-m.S) = -((N*M)*m.S) := Int.mul_neg _ _
  rw [e] at h6
  first | omega | grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: shared-claude
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M h hM hN hS _
  have h2 : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos h (Int.mul_pos hM hM)
  have h3 : N * (m.S * M) ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hN
  have heq : m.modeDet N M = m.detJ * (M * M) - N * (m.S * M) + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  rw [heq]
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: shared-claude
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h6 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := by omega
  have := T05 m N M h1 h2 h3 h6 h4
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: shared-claude
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s h1 h2 h3 h4 n hn
  have hp : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    have e : p ^ 2 = p * p := by simp [Int.pow_succ]
    rw [e]
    exact Int.mul_pos h2 h2
  have hs : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have hn' : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have k : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) ^ 2 := by
    have e : (n:Int) ^ 2 = n * n := by simp [Int.pow_succ]
    rw [e]
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn' hn' (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa using this
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) hs
  have k2 : 1 * s ^ 2 ≤ (n:Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right k hs
  have k3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 h3
  have hle : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeM Scope.modeN
    have : m.Du * m.Dv * (1 * s ^ 2) = m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := by simp
    rw [this] at k3
    exact Int.le_trans h4 k3
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ h1 hp hN hle h3)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: shared-gemini
name: T02
source:
theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2
